task.goal: Compile a governed Builder contract for the CAR-LST-Avoidance format: a 10-slide illustrated-quote carousel that walks a single relational-avoidance pattern template across a sequence and closes on a product CTA card.
task.success_condition: Slide order, per-slide illustration/copy pairing, and the terminal CTA card are preserved as one atomic sequence; no slide is compiled or served as a standalone unit.
task.atomic_boundary: One selected behavioral-pattern premise becomes one ordered 10-slide carousel contract, ending in exactly one CTA card.

source_expression_moment.description: The single behavioral-pattern premise driving this carousel pass, e.g. 'people who don't know how to X think Y is an attack'.

voice_context.description: Creator/brand voice context for this pass (tone, POV, sign-off style). Optional; not identity lineage evidence.

activative_input.hidden_pressure: The viewer wants to recognize a partner's or their own avoidance pattern without feeling personally diagnosed or exposed.
stakes: avoid finger-pointing at a specific real relationship
preserve the arc across all 10 slides
identity_urges: see the pattern as common, not personally damning
activative_input.participation_design: Sequential swipe through 10 slides, closing on a low-friction comment-to-DM CTA.
activative_input.intended_reaction: The viewer recognizes a communication pattern in their own relationships and engages with the CTA out of resonance, not guilt.
activative_input.smallest_useful_commitment: Comment the CTA keyword to receive the linked resource.
wrong_reading_locks: Do not compile or surface any single slide (e.g. slide 1 or 2) as a standalone single-frame graphic — the template only carries its intended meaning as an ordered sequence culminating in the CTA card; isolated, a slide reads as a random claim rather than a recognizable pattern arc.

Do not let the recurring 'people who don't know how to X think Y is an attack' template be interpreted as a diagnostic label pointed at a specific named person; doctrine intent is generalized pattern-recognition, not accusation of an identifiable individual.

Do not treat the closing lifestyle-photo CTA card (slide 10) as organic found content or as commercial ad creative requiring a separate rights-clearance pass — it is a templated first-party promo end-card for the harness's own linked product, not licensed third-party media.

Do not re-skin the high-contrast 'shadow figure' illustrations (slides 1–2) toward horror/true-crime visual grammar — the dark, featureless rendering signals emotional distance within a relationship-communication narrative, not a genre-horror cue.
wrong_reading_locks_meaning: Do not shame the participant for avoidance behaviors -- PRM-PSY-018 diagnoses avoidance as protective intelligence.
Do not overload the closing slide with complex homework -- EXP-FBK-004 mandates smallest useful commitment.
